name: round_turn_and_two_half_hitches
title: Round turn and two half hitches
about: Ties a rope to a ring, a rail or a post so that it can be cast off under load: two turns round it, which take the strain, then two half hitches round the rope's own standing part. Shown loose and flat.

steps.caption: The rod, rail or ring the rope is tied to.
Bring the end up over the rod in front and down behind it: one turn.
And round once more, beside the first turn: over the rod and down behind it. That is the round turn.
First half hitch: take the end across over the standing part, back under it, and down over its own part.
Second half hitch, below the first and made the same way: over the standing part, back under it, and out over its own part.
